## Triage (2026-11-08)

Verified against current `main` (`9dae02a921`) after fast-forward; issue remains open, has no hard-stop labels, and no open PR for this work was found.

### Current state and evidence

- The socket-listener portion is already landed in merged [PR #6514](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/6514), which closes [#6216](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/6216). `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-config/src/lib.rs` now has `queue_broker_socket()` and `secrets_broker_socket()`, and `fleet-queue` dual-binds those sockets alongside TCP.
- That does **not** satisfy this issue's full scope: the helpers currently resolve environment variable → compiled default (`~/.config/queue-broker/broker.sock` / `~/.config/secrets-broker/broker.sock`); they have no config-file override and do not use the requested `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/fleet/<role>.sock` / state-dir fallback. `fleet-config` also has no per-role `transport = "socket" | "tcp"` preference fields/getters. The existing `[search] via` plus `deny_unknown_fields` pattern is a nearby precedent.

### Triage outcome / next step

Keep #6215 open as the remaining `fleet-config` follow-up; do not duplicate #6216 or its merged PR. Implement the documented env → config → default resolution and per-role transport preferences, preserving deny-unknown-fields behavior, with tests for precedence, defaults, and accepted preference values. First settle/document compatibility for the already-landed `QUEUE_BROKER_SOCKET` / `SECRETS_BROKER_SOCKET` defaults when adopting the requested XDG/state-dir defaults. No external blocker or ordering dependency remains: #6216 is already merged.
